walk_notes: ⚠️ HAND-WALKED, NOT GENERATED. This file previously carried the generator
trust warning AND a line saying it was written by hand — a contradiction that
told a reader to distrust rows no generator ever produced. The generator
warning is removed because it does not apply here; the provenance stays.
It also carried `generator_version: hand`, which is a category error: that
field records WHICH GENERATOR VERSION produced a file, so "hand" means the
field should not be present at all. ⚠️ Not cosmetic — backing-monitor's emitter
refuses any truthy generator_version, so this hand-walk was refused as machine
output and its page froze. The correct encoding of "hand-walked" is the field's
ABSENCE plus `walked_by: hand` per layer, which was already here.
